stem:
Kabir writes numbers with Roman landmarks: I $=1$, V $=5$, X $=10$, L $=50$. He wants to represent $36$.

Which plan follows landmark decomposition?

options.text: The plan is the label "Roman numerals".
Take three X for $30$, one V for $5$, and one I for $1$, giving XXXVI.
Pick XXXVI only because $36$ is the printed target.

teacher.key_rationale: Largest useful landmarks first: three X (30), then V (5), then I (1) → XXXVI. A labels the system. B skips landmarks. D grabs the printed target.
